meta.summary: AI spend governed at 10.0x sector median with loose guardrails to support rapid scaling while preserving agent safety and shadow AI visibility.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are reimbursable up to $50/month per employee only when the tool has no equivalent on the approved allowlist and the employee submits a business justification within 7 days of purchase.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn exceeds 90% before month day 20, or any single session exceeds $200
Team envelope burn exceeds 110% of monthly allocation or company envelope exceeds 95% with more than 5 days remaining
Company envelope exceeds 120% of monthly allocation or any agent task exceeds kill threshold of $80/hour

rationales.e1: Production inference at $211/day for the support-triage service is tagged to the production-inference project tag, correctly classified as COGS under the prod environment rule, and sits within the Engineering team envelope of $4,500/month.
rationales.e2: The nightly embeddings job at $38 is attributed to the Data team, falls well within the $1,200 Data team envelope, and requires no action.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight with flat volume, breaching the 60% variance band on the Engineering envelope; the most likely cause is an unintentional model upgrade or prompt expansion in the deploy, and the team lead is alerted to investigate.
rationales.e4: This is the third ChatGPT Team subscription on the Marketing employee card this quarter, which has not yet reached the team_subscription_threshold of 5 duplicate subscriptions; the charge is flagged for visibility per the shadow AI flag rule but not rerouted.
rationales.e5: Fine-tune estimate 4800 against the 15000 approval line. Approved.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 calls per hour, exceeding the max_retries_per_task limit of 50 and the kill_threshold_usd_per_hour of $80; the agent is blocked immediately, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: The Growth team frontier-model exception for the demo build is self-serve eligible under the loose routing policy, falls within the 168-hour window, and the incremental cost is within the $1,000 max_delta_usd cap; the exception is approved.
rationales.e8: Usage at 22x baseline with no project tag. Throttled per the response ladder.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent's $499 dataset license purchase is within the agent card single_txn_ceiling_usd of $750 and falls under the data-licensing merchant scope; the transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team's $89/month AI video tool trial overlaps with the Sales team's existing $1,400/year contract at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value and the trial is rerouted.
rationales.e11: Unrecognized provider under a allow_with_review new-provider rule. Approved.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged to the internal-tooling project tag is classified as OpEx under the internal-tooling rule; the COGS classification is corrected and the tagging team is notified to apply the correct tag at job submission.
rationales.e13: Company spend at 87% of envelope against a 90% burn alert, 9 days left. Approved.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup is complete; all team envelopes, agent guardrails, and classification rules are within policy parameters and no open exceptions remain.
